name: hide-error-cases
description: Hides error case codes of .go file.

go.hideErrorCases.autoFold.description: Automatically fold error case codes on opening .go files by text editor.

go.hideErrorCases.autoMakeTransparent.description: Automatically make error case codes transparent on opening .go files by text editor.

go.hideErrorCases.hideOnSave.description: Performs auto-fold/auto-make-transparent above also on saving .go files.

go.hideErrorCases.errorCasesOpacity.description: The opacity of error case codes.

go.hideErrorCases.errorTypeRegexp.description: The regexp for the types that will be recognized as error types.

scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && cp -rf src/parser out/ && rm -rf out/parser/test-inputs out/parser/main_test.go
scripts.pretest: yarn run compile && yarn run lint
